use_cases: Create scroll-animated card stacks for interactive product showcases
Build layered feature or pricing comparisons with sticky stacking

ai_summary: A scroll-animated card stacking component using Framer Motion that leverages CSS sticky positioning to create layered card effects. ContainerScroll provides a 3D perspective wrapper while CardSticky handles individual card positioning with configurable Y-offset and Z-index increments. The layout animation ensures smooth reordering. Ideal for creating interactive showcases, feature comparisons, or scroll-driven storytelling experiences.
